title: Richard E. Cook
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Clea Searle 1950, Salt Lake Temple; four children
Bishop, Stake High Councilor, Counselor to Stake president
Married Mary Nielsen 1988, Salt Lake Temple
Released from Second Quorum of the Seventy Oct. 2001
Finance Director of Perpetual Education Fund 2001 - present
